product_family: Zillow AI mode: conversational real estate assistant (launched March 2026) with guided intelligence for home search, powered by custom AI models integrated with ChatGPT for MLS data access. Also includes AI-powered virtual staging and real estate agent tools (Zillow Pro).

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found in SEC 10-K filings or official security documentation. Zillow's 10-K references NIST Cybersecurity Framework and Cyber Risk Institute Cyber Profile but does not claim SOC 2 certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. While Zillow conducts internal audit teams' security controls testing and engages external auditors for compliance testing, ISO 27001 certification is not mentioned in SEC filings or official documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of formal GDPR certification; GDPR is a regulation, not a certification. The vendor's privacy notice is reported by secondary sources to invoke GDPR and UK GDPR legal bases (Article 6) for EEA and UK residents, though the on-page wording could not be independently confirmed.

certifications.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Zillow's information security function is 'informed by standards promoted by the National Institute of Standards and Technology cybersecurity framework.' Security program design guided by Cyber Risk Institute's Cyber Profile.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. HIPAA (health insurance portability) is not applicable to Zillow's core real estate business and is not mentioned in compliance documentation.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found in available documentation. While Zillow processes financial data for real estate transactions, PCI DSS certification is not explicitly claimed in SEC filings or public security pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: The ChatGPT integration is designed to prevent data reuse for training: 'ChatGPT cannot use data displayed in the Zillow App outside of the Zillow experience and does not retain any record of what Zillow displayed.' OpenAI cannot train on IDX (MLS) data; Zillow worked with OpenAI to restrict any use of Zillow App data for training. Zillow AI mode uses custom AI models trained on Zillow's own data, and the training posture for internal models on customer interaction data is not explicitly disclosed as opt-out-able.
privacy.data_region: US-based (Zillow is a US company; data residency specifics not publicly documented)

products.name: Zillow AI Mode
products.data_scope: Zillow listing data, user search history (remembered across sessions), public property information
products.notes: Launched March 2026. Conversational AI assistant with Fair Housing Classifier. ChatGPT-integrated but with explicit data isolation (no training on user queries or Zillow responses). Uses custom AI models on Zillow data. Fair housing guardrails applied.

products.name: Zillow App in ChatGPT
products.data_scope: MLS listing data only (no access to user identity or search history via ChatGPT)
products.notes: Real estate app in ChatGPT (only major real estate app integrated). ChatGPT cannot retain data or use for training. OpenAI cannot train on IDX data. Data flow: ChatGPT sends query to Zillow, Zillow returns listing, no data flow to ChatGPT for training.

products.name: Zillow Pro (Agent Tools)
products.data_scope: Agent MLS data, client contacts, transaction history
products.notes: AI-powered agent suite. Enterprise/team tier offering with compliance requirements for MLS data handling.

products.name: Virtual Staging AI
products.data_scope: Property photos uploaded by sellers or agents
products.notes: AI-powered virtual staging for home listings. Allows agents/sellers to apply design styles (modern, Scandinavian, farmhouse, etc.) to photos.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (consumer Zillow AI mode free; Zillow Pro subscription for agents; enterprise API access available through Bridge Interactive)
compare.data_residency: US-based; specific data residency regions not publicly documented

flags: Zillow is a large enterprise with sophisticated security practices (CISO, internal audits, third-party assessments, NIST alignment) but does not publicly hold formal third-party certifications such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, despite being a major B2B and B2C platform. Zillow relies on internal controls and regulatory compliance rather than third-party certification.

The ChatGPT integration is well-documented with data isolation and no-training guarantees. However, Zillow AI mode's own custom AI models' training on customer interaction data (for example, user preferences and search patterns across sessions) is not explicitly disclosed as opt-out-able or restricted.
No Data Processing Agreement is mentioned on public pages. Enterprise or B2B customers may have negotiated DPAs, but no standard vendor-facing DPA document is publicly available.

While Zillow processes financial data in real estate transactions and offers agent and investor tools, no HIPAA or PCI DSS certifications are claimed. HIPAA applies to healthcare only; PCI DSS may apply to payment processing but is not claimed.

The vendor is Zillow Group Inc. (NASDAQ: ZG), a public company operating a real estate platform. Zillow AI is its generative AI mode, launched Q1 2026. There is no conflation with similarly named vendors.
